en.headline: Customs seizes HK$1 million counterfeit goods before Golden Week
en.dek: Officers searched 17 fixed hawker stalls in Yau Ma Tei and Mong Kok and arrested seven stall operators after finding about 3,100 suspected fake items.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it had seized about 3,100 suspected counterfeit items worth an estimated HK$1 million in special operations on 3 and 8 September in Yau Ma Tei and Mong Kok, ahead of the mainland National Day Golden Week.

Officers searched 17 fixed hawker stalls — nine on Temple Street and eight on Tung Choi Street — after patrols at tourist spots found suspected fake handbags, watches, clothing and toys. Seven stall operators, one man and six women aged 34 to 65, were arrested on suspicion of offences under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance. The department said the investigation continues and further arrests are not ruled out.

Customs said some stalls were selling suspected fakes at as little as a quarter of genuine retail prices. It said it will step up inspections during the holiday period to protect local consumers and visitors.

zh.headline: 黃金周前海關油旺檢百萬元冒牌貨拘7人
zh.dek: 海關在油麻地廟街及旺角通菜街搜查17個固定小販檔，檢約3,100件懷疑冒牌物品，拘捕7名檔主。
body: 香港海關表示，因應內地國慶黃金周將至，於9月3日及8日在油麻地及旺角採取特別行動，檢獲約3,100件懷疑冒牌物品，估計市值約100萬元。
關員在旅遊熱點巡查後，搜查17個固定小販攤檔，包括廟街9檔及通菜街8檔，檢獲懷疑冒牌手袋、手錶、衣服及玩具等。行動拘捕1男6女，年齡介乎34至65歲，均為攤檔負責人，涉嫌違反《商品說明條例》。海關指案件仍在調查，不排除有更多人被捕。
海關表示，部分檔口以低至正貨零售價四分一的價錢出售懷疑冒牌貨，黃金周期間會繼續加強巡查及執法，保障本地消費者及訪港旅客。
